language_policy: Bilingual summaries; stable machine fields in English.
scope: Documentation-only public-source research. Protocols describe expected outcomes, not executed tests.

baseline.deduplication: The four newly listed URLs were absent from existing research Markdown/JSON; the Chongqing URL was already listed. These are collection-relative classifications, not a merged total.

date_policy: Composition, publication, republication, event and access dates are distinct. Unknown displayed timezones remain null. The X post is dated on, not proven after, the previous October 1 cutoff.

priority_definitions.P0: Evidence design before any authorized pilot or scope expansion.
priority_definitions.P1: Narrow report/case design, then separately authorized user or domain validation.
priority_definitions.origin: Project inference, not source-authored priorities or maturity scores.

sources.read_scope: Issuer notice metadata; official Hunan republication and PDF I.4–I.5, printed pages 2–3 (zero-based pages 1–2).

sources.title: Lidang comment on agent infrastructure trends
sources.read_scope: Entire original post; visible author and related-profile identity fields; replies excluded.

source_paraphrase.en: The author satirizes the proliferation of agent browser, language, OS, email, CLI and skill infrastructure trends.
source_paraphrase.zh-CN: 作者讽刺 agent 浏览器、语言、操作系统、邮箱、CLI 和 skill 等基础设施热点的泛化包装。

limitations: A sarcastic personal opinion is not a customer sample, product specification or evidence that all such infrastructure fails.
Only the displayed calendar date and time were verified; no UTC conversion or exhaustive timeline coverage.
The self-described affiliation is identity context, not independent employment verification or endorsement.

sources.title: “人工智能+软件”专项行动实施方案通知
sources.read_scope: Issuer, document number, issue/publication dates and attachment entry only.

source_paraphrase.en: Notice identity and dates were reconfirmed; no attachment clause is newly asserted.
source_paraphrase.zh-CN: 仅重核通知身份和日期，不据本轮未读附件提出条款结论。

limitations: The plan attachment was not read in this integration; existing appendix reading limits remain.
No new feature mapping is derived from this metadata-only recheck.

inferred_need.en: Preserve evidence roles and detect prohibited calibration/validation ancestry after data transformations.
inferred_need.zh-CN: 数据变换后保留证据角色，识别任务禁止的校准/验证共同祖先。

proposed_feature.en: Versioned derived-record manifest containing parents, role, transform/version/parameters, output identity and intended use; report prohibited promotion or leakage.
proposed_feature.zh-CN: 版本化派生清单记录父来源、角色、变换版本/参数、产物身份和用途，报告禁止的角色升级或泄漏。

inferred_need.en: Know whether simulation and reference describe the same design and conditions, with calibration separate from validation.
inferred_need.zh-CN: 确认仿真与参照属于同一设计及工况，区分校准与验证。

proposed_feature.en: Bounded paired-evidence package; check comparability before residuals and retain NOT_VALIDATED when independent reference is absent.
proposed_feature.zh-CN: 限定场景的成对证据包，先判可比性再计算残差；缺独立参照时保持 NOT_VALIDATED。

inferred_need.en: Test whether additional infrastructure improves a fixed task before adding more categories.
inferred_need.zh-CN: 扩充工具类别前，验证新增复杂度是否改善同一任务。

proposed_feature.en: Read-only baseline/candidate comparison report with accepted outcomes, all attempts, failures, setup and review effort.
proposed_feature.zh-CN: 只读基线/候选比较报告，列出合格产物、全部尝试、失败、接入及复核成本。

inferred_need.en: A responsible person can inspect, correct and decide as execution expands.
inferred_need.zh-CN: 自动执行增加时，负责人仍可检查、纠正和作决定。

proposed_feature.en: Read-only evidence-linked handoff summary separating accepted, unreviewed, rejected and decision-pending items.
proposed_feature.zh-CN: 只读交接摘要链接证据，区分已接受、待复核、拒收和待人工决定事项。

inferred_need.en: An engineering trial identifies its scenario, input holder and accountable acceptance criteria.
inferred_need.zh-CN: 工程试点明确场景、输入持有人和验收责任。

proposed_feature.en: Reuse the existing proposed domain case package with scenario, reference criteria and applicability boundary.
proposed_feature.zh-CN: 沿用已有领域算例包提案，明确场景、参考判据和适用边界。

preconditions: Freeze allowed role transitions and partition rules before evaluating the invented records.
Retain all original, derived and failed records and the rule version.

fixture.rule: For this fixture, calibration and validation may not share ancestors.

limits: Role labels and hashes authenticate neither measurements nor rights.
A rule suitable for this fixture is not a universal statistical independence criterion.

preconditions: Freeze matching keys: design revision, material/condition and unit; reject missing keys before residuals.
Use declared decimal absolute-error tolerance 0.2 au and invented reference data; retain unmatched records and denominators.
limits: No measured data, sensor or native solver is used.
A software-contract pass cannot validate a physical object or justify replacing physical tests.

preconditions: Freeze task, versions, budget, acceptance rules and the report’s utility rule.
The invented utility rule requires more accepted outcomes with no increase in total recorded effort and no missing effort fields.
Report all attempts, failures, setup, elapsed time and review effort; the rule is a fixture choice, not a universal utility metric.
limits: Synthetic report classification is not a benchmark or proof of real benefit.
Real benefit needs a separately authorized task comparison.

preconditions: Freeze four invented records: valid reviewed output, missing evidence, rejected output, pending human decision.
Use distinct record IDs and require raw-evidence references for each status.
limits: Synthetic reviewer/approval fields prove no real consent or authority.
Review time, corrections and false acceptance require an authorized human pilot.

preconditions: Reuse a rights-cleared invented domain case with scenario, input holder, parameters, unit, tool version, reference criteria and applicability boundary.
Keep domain-user fitness confirmation separate from software completeness.
limits: A report’s claims and a synthetic completeness pass cannot substitute for domain-user confirmation.

global_limits: Policies, authored opinions and indirect reporting are different evidence types. All needs, features, oracles and priorities here are project inferences.
No customer interview, procurement, adoption, investment, endorsement, certification, compliance or eligibility evidence is established.
No runtime, provider, adapter, scheduler, permission owner, recovery owner, implementation status, test count or release claim changes.
Existing 0.3.0a2 alpha / NOT_SCORED and optional fixed single-host synthetic Temporal boundaries remain unchanged.
scientific_acceptance=false and physical_validation=false remain true limits even if a future synthetic protocol passes.
No raw third-party content or source bytes are archived here; URLs and reading scope support traceability, not immutable provenance.
The source review is bounded and does not prove no newer publication or Hillhouse-authored strategy exists.
Sequoia Capital and HongShan are distinct; the Chongqing report is not a Hillhouse-authored primary statement.
